NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Color post scores
patches.description: Colors a post's points orange when positive and purple when negative. The more points a post has, the stronger the color.

patches.name: Keep links in post previews
patches.description: Keeps links in the text under a post tappable in feed previews, where Sync otherwise drops them. Only the links are restored, so the text keeps the size chosen in the app's settings.

patches.name: Show commenter's top subreddits
patches.description: Adds a line under each comment with the three subreddits the commenter is most active in, worked out from their recent public activity on Project Arctic Shift. Answers are cached per author; comments without a cache entry ask the archive in the background.

patches.name: Use /user/ for profiles
patches.description: Replaces the deprecated /u profile endpoint with /user, which Reddit still serves. User profile requests (about, friend and unfriend) use this path, so profiles fail to load without it.
